newsitem.title: USA: Rambus shares released from lock-up.
newsitem.headline: Rambus shares released from lock-up.

text.p: Rambus Inc said Wednesaday that about 750,000 of its shares had been released from lock-up restrictions related to its initial public offering.
The company said Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, which served as lead underwriter on the IPO, released the shares on Tuesday.
Rambus made an initial public offering of about 3.2 million shares on May 13.
The released shares, currently held by certain Rambus shareholders, will be available for sale subject to federal securities laws, including Rule 144 limitations, the company said.
